note: Global site header -- renders: Booking.com logo, language/currency, sign in, register, and fixed service tabs (Stays, Flights, Car rentals, etc.)
Global site footer -- renders: fixed navigation links (Support, Partners, etc.), legal links, and language/currency controls
Cookie consent banner -- renders: operator-authored privacy policy text and fixed action buttons (Accept, Reject, Settings)
Hotel page section tabs -- renders: fixed tab labels (Overview, Availability, Facilities, Policies, Fine print, Reviews)
Top booking bar -- renders: fixed action buttons (Wishlist, Share, Book now, Price guarantee)
Hotel header controls -- renders: fixed action buttons (Wishlist, Share, Map) and star rating label
Review scorecard widget -- renders: fixed score labels (Exceptional, Score) and review count
Sidebar map widget -- renders: fixed 'Show on map' button
Availability section chrome -- renders: fixed 'Availability' heading, date summary, and search controls; subtracts the room table which contains seller-defined room names and descriptions
Facilities section -- renders: fixed section heading and facility names (e.g., Free WiFi, Pool) which are standard platform vocabulary
User survey widget -- renders: operator-authored survey question and fixed rating options
Policies section -- renders: fixed policy headings and standard policy text (Check-in, Check-out, Children, etc.)
Important info section -- renders: fixed section heading and standard disclaimer text
FAQ section -- renders: fixed section heading and operator-authored FAQ questions
